canonical_statement: The study evaluated whether montelukast given to hospitalized patients with confirmed COVID-19 was associated with less clinical deterioration on the COVID-19 Ordinal Scale.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: The objective of this retrospective review was to evaluate the change in clinical deterioration following montelukast administration.

canonical_statement: This was an IRB-approved retrospective study conducted at Robert Wood Johnson University Hospital, Rutgers University, in New Brunswick, New Jersey.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: We conducted a retrospective, IRB-approved, study at Robert Wood Johnson University Hospital, Rutgers University (Pro2020001307).

canonical_statement: Investigators screened 256 hospitalized patients and analyzed 92 patients: 30 who received montelukast and 62 controls who did not.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Two hundred and fifty-six patients were screened for the following factors: hospitalization length of stay and montelukast.

canonical_statement: Baseline categorical variables were compared with Fisher’s exact test; continuous variables used an independent two-sample t test or Wilcoxon rank-sum test according to distribution.

canonical_statement: Clinical deterioration was assessed with univariate logistic regression and a multivariable logistic model limited to montelukast receipt and age because of the small number of events.
